description: Romania work permit / work visa from Pakistan: requirements, documents, fees, timeline, mistakes and FAQ. SK Immigration Services, Rawalpindi.

faqs.question: How to get a Romania work permit from Pakistan?
faqs.answer: You typically need a genuine Romania job offer/authorization, then a complete national visa file. SK Immigration prepares the Pakistan-side documents from PKR 80,000; authorities decide.

faqs.question: What documents are needed for Romania work visa?
faqs.answer: Passport, contract/authorization, CV, certificates, and any medical/police documents requested. Exact lists vary — we build a checklist for your case.

faqs.question: SK Immigration Romania work fee?
faqs.answer: From PKR 80,000 for preparation support. Official fees are separate. No guarantees.

faqs.question: Do I need local language for Romania?
faqs.answer: Often helpful; some international roles use English. We assess language before you invest.

faqs.question: Can I convert a visit visa to work in Romania?
faqs.answer: Not as a DIY loophole. Work needs the correct authorization. We advise legal routes only.

faqs.question: Do you guarantee the visa?
faqs.answer: No. Immigration authorities decide every application.
